column1: # Declared dev servers. `cmd+k s` starts every server whose session matches
# the one you are in. If a serve/* window exists but its program has died
# (which is what a restored window looks like), it is restarted in place.
# Output is piped to ~/.local/state/tmux/serve/<session>-<name>.log, so logs
# outlive both the window and a crash.
# The port column is not decoration: many dev servers silently fall back to a
# random port when theirs is taken, and then you are looking at a different
# server than you think. Declare it and you get told instead.
# Use - if the server has no fixed port.
# Servers are deliberately not restarted on boot. resurrect brings back the
# serve/* windows so you can see what should be running; starting is one key.
